The Program Analyst for PA&I performs a wide range of analyses, reporting, project management, and training activities.

The position's responsibilities include but are limited to the following: Determine stakeholder information needs as per business requirements using data warehouse artifacts such as tables, applicable table relationships, data marts and views used to fulfill ADHOC data request Analyzes, designs, develops, troubleshoots and debugs complex SQL and PL*SQL code to address stakeholder ADHOC requirements.

Communicates complex technical information and business concepts both in writing and verbally to stakeholders, subordinates, peers and leadership Create technical solutions by developing user response documentation, code comments and clear code.

Preparing and releasing correspondences for use by other federal, state and local agencies Inform PA and I management of issues and events arising because of reviews and analyses for which the incumbent is assigned Experience in database modeling, including data mart design, data cataloging management, and meta-data management in a Data Warehouse Environments.

Provide PA&I Leadership with status updates on the projects and data architecture enhancements Assist in planning, coordination, and implementation of data marts and data architecture solutions supporting the Enterprise Data Warehouse Database internal and external partners Create an optimal EDW data architecture design through data analysis and requirements elicitation Collaborate with end users and contractor to identify needs and opportunities for improved data management and delivery Develop end to end data warehousing solutions involving Informatica ETL development and front end visualization with Power BI, OBIEE or Tableau.

Promotion Potential: None Work Schedule: Full time, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM Compressed/Flexible: Available Telework: This position is eligible for situational (ad hoc) telework only. The selectee is required to report to the official duty station each scheduled workday.

Telework may be approved only on a case-by-case basis with supervisory approval. Routine or recurring telework is not authorized for this position. Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENT: You may qualify based on your experience as described below: GS-13 Specialized Experience: Applicants must have one (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade (GS-12) in the federal, state, local, public, or private sector.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as: Designing, developing and implementing complex Structured Query Language (SQL) or Procedural Language Extensions (PL/SQL) in a business environment.

OR, designing and developing frontend solutions utilizing OBIEE, PowerBI or APEX; data warehousing development and architecture experience; leveraging data marts, working with Informatica or with Extra Transfer Loading (ETL) tools, and the ability to perform tune Oracle Procedural Language Extensions (PL/SQL) and Structured Query Language (SQL).

Note: Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religions; spiritual; community; student; social).

As a Program Analyst (Financial Program Analyst), GS-0343-12, your typical work assignments may include: Preparing recurring and ad hoc travel obligation and expenditures reports and provide monthly financial reporting and analysis report to the Budget Team to support budget planning, monitoring and decision making.

Providing support to improve the accuracy and completeness of requisition submissions, enhance compliance with procurement requirements and reduce processing delays. Compiling financial data and preparing variety of ad hoc and reoccurring reports to analyze and resolve reporting issues.

Working closely with the NLRB Ethics office, the Nonfederal Sponsors and travelers to coordinate and track reimbursement requests, reconcile expenses, and ensure compliance with applicable policies and reporting requirements.
All qualifications and eligibility requirements must be met by the closing date of the announcement. IDEAL CANDIDATE STATEMENT The ideal candidate for the Program Analyst (Financial Program Analyst) will have experience working with and analyzing travel reports.

Knowledge of travel policies and guidelines to ensure compliance throughout organizations. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with stakeholders, senior level management, and colleagues; and strong analytical skills are desired.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Applicants must have one year of specialized experience, equivalent to the GS-11 grade level, which has provided them with the knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the Program Analyst (Financial Program Analyst) at the GS-12 grade level.

Specialized experience includes: Experience tracking travel requests through automated systems and responding to travel inquiries; and Experience updating and implementing travel policy; and Experience overseeing the requisitions process to ensure compliance with organizational and budget guidelines.

This experience must be fully supported and articulated in your resume to receive consideration. Please do not cut and paste the specialized experience from this announcement into your resume, as this will not be considered a demonstration of your qualifications for this position.

Substitution of education in lieu of specialized experience may not be used for this grade level. For more detailed information on these qualification standards, please visit the United States Office of Personnel Management's website here.

NOTE: Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student; social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.
The duties described are for the full-performance level. At developmental grade levels, assignments will be of more limited scope, performed with less independence and limited complexity.

The Chief, BIDS, expends considerable effort planning, prioritizing, scheduling, assigning, and evaluating work based on its specific technical requirements, and matching that with appropriately skilled experience subordinates, for short-term activities, longer-term initiatives, and for ongoing production.

The incumbent reviews and advises on progress through analysis, observation, and positive interaction articulating both successes and areas for further focus. Establishes and sustains cooperative relationships with other resources in VBA and VA.

Displays leadership skills in leading SAFe Agile teams executing software development through articulation and direction of strategic initiatives, LGY Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and special projects. Engages stakeholders throughout the development process.

Provides organization expertise in developing measurable objectives and supporting various teams. Coaches, counsels, provides feedback on the work to maintain positive communication, engagement, and transparency with staff individually and collectively. The incumbent's communication efforts focus both on performance and behavior.

Provides proactive, well-planned communications of all types and media to program participants and LGY leadership, including complete and accurate end products, recommendations regarding LGY business needs, self-serve program analytics capabilities and program analysis are provided to program participants, field stations, VACO staff, and others.

Advises project and other stakeholders, including the Agile Management Office on status, directly and through Planview. Ensures that teams effectively utilize a SAFe Agile lean environment for software development, including the application of core SAFe competencies throughout any effort, to the extent that Data team members sit on ART teams.

Directly responsible for interpreting the VA/VBA/LGY All Employee Survey (AES) as it pertains to the PMDI/Data team and its members. The Chief takes affirmative actions to cause improvements using realistic action plans to improve perceptions of employee experience as measured by, for example, future year AES scoring.

Utilizes analytical skill, sound judgment, and the capability to understand, report, and address the implications and ramifications of program/project management, controls, and procedures applicable to the program.

Establishes and governs an enterprise data governance implementation roadmap including strategic priorities for development of analytics-based capabilities. Promotion Potential: Full performance level is GS-14.

Serves as a junior analyst at the IMCOM Headquarters level performing a variety of analytical duties for one or more program areas. Assists supervisor or senior program analyst in the administration of processes and analytical support associated with assigned program areas.

Determines data required for analysis and devises appropriate methods for securing required information from sources such as reports, surveys, on-site investigations, discussions with officials, statutes, policies, plans, schedules, etc. Analyzes issues, selects and applies accepted analytical techniques.

Develops initial conclusions and recommendations for problems analyzed for submission to senior analyst or supervisor. May oversee operating procedures for a variety of administrative and/or program support functions.
RESUMES MUST BE TWO PAGES (OR LESS). QUALIFICATIONS MUST BE CLEARLY VERIFIABLE IN YOUR RESUME. GOVERNMENT POSITIONS MUST INCLUDE PAY PLAN, SERIES, GRADE, TO AND FROM DATES, AND GOVERNMENT AGENCY/DEPARTMENT.

Must include at least one year of experience performing duties at a level which equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to perform successfully in the position. Applicants must have experience performing work similar to the duties listed above.

Documented experience must have been equivalent in complexity and difficulty to the next lower grade/level. Possess knowledge of the basic principles, concepts and methodologies required to perform various analytical techniques and develop initial conclusions.

Possess experience collecting and determining the data required for analysis and creating methods for measuring performance. Possess experience working collaboratively to develop strategies to address and resolve problems.

All Qualified applicants will be rated against the highly qualifying criteria by a rating panel for evaluation of the quality and extent of your total accomplishments, experience and education. Those applicants determined to be highly qualified will be referred to the hiring official for consideration.

The highly qualified candidates may undergo an interview and reference checks. Highly Qualifying Criteria: Possess work experience as a research assistant/specialist/analyst/manager/analyst, biostatistician, data analyst, business analyst, mathematician, actuary or similar demonstratable in your resume.

Possess a Bachelor's degree in Operations Research, Business Administration, Economics, Sociology, Statistics, Psychology, Demography, Engineering, Mathematics, Political Science, Actuarial Science, or similar.

Possess demonstrated experience using Microsoft Power applications, especially developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards All answers to the Highly Qualifying Criteria must be demonstrated in your resume to get credit.

Serving as a Management Analyst GS-0343-9/11 makes you a valuable member of the Federal Law Enforcement Training Centers (FLETC) team and mission. This position is located in the Core Training Operations Directorate under the Office of the Associate Director for Training Operations.

The primary purpose of this position is to provide analysis and administrative support. Typical duties include: Performing in-depth analysis of sensitive and complex administrative issues affecting the office, develops solutions, and implements new or modified guidelines to address operational challenges and enhance mission effectiveness.

Serving as the directorate-level point of contact for documentation management, leading the coordination, organization, and optimization of documentation workflows across platforms such as SharePoint, Internet, and Intranet, ensuring secure and efficient storage, retrieval, and lifecycle management.

Providing expert guidance and training to managers and staff on documentation management tools, procedures, and best practices, and resolves issues related to system use, documentation processes, and compliance with organizational policies.

Participating in strategic long-range planning, reviews and evaluates reports and correspondence for leadership, and assists with the preparation and quality control of directorate documentation, ensuring consistency, clarity, and alignment with administrative and policy requirements.

The Associate Chief Counsel (Finance & Management) supports the administrative, financial, and managerial programs of the Office of Chief Counsel and provides advice to the Chief Counsel and Deputy Chief Counsel on all management matters for the organization nationwide.

This position, in the Planning & Finance Division, performs a range of duties including data querying and analysis, budget planning and execution, survey administration and analysis, and strategic planning.

Analysts in PFD also partner with Human Resources, Talent Management, Business Systems Planning and other Counsel functions to deliver on cross-functional programs and projects related to employee engagement, organizational development, and Enterprise Risk Management.

As a Management Analyst, you will: Conduct in depth, independent research and analysis on a wide range of complex and sensitive management issues; Serve as project leader, consultant or a member on various project teams that resolve complex management problems and to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of operations; Create, manage, and/or query management databases containing statistical information.

Utilize appropriate programs and software tools to design and perform complex analyses and to clearly report on findings and recommendations; Gather, maintain, and analyze data related to costs and performance of a wide range of services and work products to determine return on investment, productivity, or effectiveness; Serve on task forces, ad hoc committees, teams to conduct in depth analyses of the programs and/or systems studied.

Participate in operational reviews and audits of management information systems and other processes for the purpose of improving the efficiency and effectiveness and assessing internal controls, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations. This is not an all-inclusive list.

If selected at a lower grade level, you will have the opportunity to learn to perform the duties of the position, and will receive training to help you grow in the position.

Participates in meetings with agency leadership and other federal officials to exchange information, investigate issues, present recommendations, and collaboratively resolve problems. The Mission We are seeking a Senior IT Business Analyst who excels at bridging product strategy, engineering, data, and AI-augmented development.

As a force multiplier for the engineering team, you will decode complex business challenges into clear, implementation-ready specifications, utilize AI tools to expedite analysis, and maximize the time engineers spend writing code rather than untangling ambiguity.

Why This Role Matters As Life Science Connect evolves into a modern data authority, our ability to move quickly without sacrificing quality depends on exceptional product definition and technical clarity.

The Senior IT Business Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring engineers spend their time building innovative solutions—not deciphering requirements.

Translate Strategy into Engineering Execution: Partner with Product Leadership and Engineering to transform strategic initiatives into clear technical requirements, user stories, workflows, APIs, and acceptance criteria that engineers can immediately build from.

Drive AI-Augmented Analysis: Use modern AI tools to rapidly produce requirements, process models, technical documentation, and data mappings while maintaining exceptional structural accuracy and logical consistency.

Design Intelligent Product Workflows: Analyze complex business processes and design scalable workflows that leverage identity, personalization, analytics, AI services, and customer intelligence across our product ecosystem.

Validate What We Build: Support testing, feature validation, and release readiness by ensuring delivered functionality aligns perfectly with business objectives and technical specifications.

You may qualify based on your experience as described below: Specialized Experience: You must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade GS-13 in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization. Directing G-Invoicing activities related to interagency reimbursable agreements; Completing complex and time-sensitive special projects with broad operational impact; Performing advanced management and program analysis in a large federal organization; Serving as the principal authority for administering, overseeing, and reconciling financial transactions processed through the Integrated Financial and Acquisition Management System (iFAMS); Conducting highly technical management analysis functions such as quarterly account reconciliations, evaluation and execution of reimbursable agreements, analysis of customer funding sufficiency, workload projections, utilization trends, and financial performance metrics.

POS-12956 HubSpot 's Legal team is extremely technology-forward. Attorneys who believe that AI and great systems can transform how legal work gets done.

Our Legal Technology team exists at the center of that bet: we build the AI agents, manage the systems and integrate their operational infrastructure which lets our lawyers focus on high-value legal work instead of manual process. This isn't a "keep the lights on" role.

You'll implement AI-powered solutions, design agentic workflows, implement and own SaaS solutions heavy with AI and sit alongside AI-minded legal stakeholders. If you want to do work that matters, is visible, and drives value for in-house Legal teams with AI, this is it. What You'll Do
Lead AI solution design and delivery: build, configure, and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows using tools like Claude, Cowork, ChatGPT, and Glean within and across legal applications. This is real implementation work, not exploration.
Own the legal tech ecosystem as part of our team: serve as one of the technical SMEs across Legal SaaS applications (CLMs, Matter Management, DSAR tooling and more), driving reliability, optimization, and integration quality.
Build integrations: design and develop workflow automations and integrations using Workato and similar iPaaS platforms, connecting legal systems to the broader HubSpot stack.
Translate business needs into technical solutions: partner directly with attorneys and legal leadership to understand workflows, surface opportunities, and deliver solutions with measurable impact.
Drive AI adoption: work alongside the legal team to identify opportunities to embed AI tools (Claude, Glean, Harvey, Workato AI, and others) into day-to-day legal workflows, and support enablement so adoption actually sticks.
Shape the roadmap: contribute to a technically feasible product roadmap, balancing strategic priorities with iterative delivery.
Track and communicate value: develop KPIs and reporting to demonstrate the business impact of technology investments to senior legal leadership, including the CLO.
Stay ahead of the curve: monitor the rapidly evolving legal tech landscape and bring forward-looking perspective on tools, capabilities, and trends.

Strong hands-on technical skills: SaaS application configuration, API usage, system integration design, and workflow automation
Real experience building and deploying AI solutions in enterprise environments: AI agents, agentic workflows, LLM-powered tools, or similar
Experience with iPaaS platforms for building integrations and automations
Demonstrated ability to operate as a technical consultant to a non-technical business audience: learn and understand business context, problem solve, and translate ambiguous needs into scoped, deliverable solutions
Self-directed, highly organized, and able to manage multiple workstreams with autonomy
Clear communicator, equally comfortable in a Slack thread with a lawyer and a design doc with an engineer

Experience working in or with legal departments: in-house legal teams, law firms, or legal tech vendors
Familiarity with legal technology applications: CLM systems, matter management, or legal service management platforms
Experience with enterprise AI tools in a professional context (Claude, Glean, ChatGPT Enterprise, or similar)

The Clinical Business Analyst plays a pivotal role in enabling Clario , a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific's Imaging business units to deliver high-impact solutions that improve patient outcomes.

This role bridges scientific, operational, and technical teams to ensure study configurations and software solutions are tailored to meet complex clinical trial requirements.

You will collaborate across departments to define and document business requirements, support product enhancements, and ensure successful delivery of study-specific technology solutions. Join us in transforming lives by unlocking better evidence. What You'll Be Doing
Analyze, interpret, and translate clinical study documentation, including protocols, imaging charters, procedure manuals, and scientific requirements into detailed business and functional software requirements.
Gather, document, review, and manage study-specific business and system requirements to support accurate software configuration and implementation.
Develop and maintain client configuration specifications, business requirements documents, workflows, use cases, and supporting project documentation.
Collaborate with scientific, operational, client-facing, and technology teams to validate requirements and ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure study requirements are clearly understood and successfully implemented.
Review system configurations and software solutions to confirm compliance with approved study requirements and customer expectations.
Support software validation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), installation, deployment, and issue resolution activities.
Perform impact assessments and support change control activities related to study requirements, system enhancements, and configuration updates.
Utilize Jira and related tools to manage requirements, user stories, defects, risks, and project documentation.
Collaborate with Product Management to support product enhancements, new functionality, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Work closely with Clinical Project Management and Operations teams to support study kickoffs, software build activities, scope changes, and project timelines.
Partner with Medical & Scientific Affairs teams to ensure scientific requirements and study documentation remain aligned with configured solutions.
Collaborate with Clinical Data Management teams to ensure alignment between data collection, database structures, data transfers, and study requirements.
Identify risks, propose mitigation strategies, and escalate issues as appropriate to support successful project delivery.
Maintain compliance with company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), quality standards, and departmental processes.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of SOPs, work instructions, quick reference guides (QRGs), and other controlled documentation.
Participate in training programs, internal meetings, and knowledge-sharing initiatives to maintain technical and industry expertise.
What We Look For
Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in clinical research, medical writing, project management, business analysis, clinical data management, or a related role supporting technology solutions in a clinical trial environment.
Previous experience within clinical trials and understanding of clinical research processes preferred.
Previous experience supporting medical imaging studies preferred.
Proven expertise in developing software configuration specifications, business requirements, functional requirements, and related system documentation.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex clinical study requirements into clear, detailed, and testable software requirements.
Experience collaborating with software development, validation, quality assurance, product management, and operational teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Experience working with Jira, requirements management tools, and business analysis platforms preferred.
Strong documentation, analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
Experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT), software validation, and issue resolution activities preferred.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and other business software tools.
Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment.
Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated ability to work independently while maintaining a collaborative and customer-focused approach.
Adaptability and flexibility to support evolving business priorities and project requirements.
Professional, positive, and solution-oriented mindset.

This includes a critical role in providing technical assistance for management of the BH IRB & RDC and a pivotal role in monitoring compliance with and follow-up of annual research staff reporting requirements; assisting the BH Research Regulatory Affairs team, assisting in the development and implementation of training documents and policy & procedures; assisting with the day-to-day operations and maintaining tracking systems for the department.

1. Maintains knowledge of current IRB and HIPAA research regulations and Banner policies. Under supervision of HRPP and IRB leadership, analyzes, interprets and applies all applicable regulations, Banner Health policies and ethical principles governing human subject research for program impacts.
2. Assists IRB leadership with oversight and management of the daily operations of the IRB office. Serves as liaison between the IRB and RDC and the research team. 4. Coordinates the orientation, education and training of board members. Trains new research staff on the IRB electronic submission system. Ensures research staff and IRB members understand compliance obligations by overseeing development and dissemination of guidance through effective education and outreach methods.
5. Assists with Association for the Accreditation of Human Research Protection Program accreditation processes.
6. Develops and updates documents, written materials and procedures for various assigned projects; including, but not limited to, annual conflict of interest (COI) disclosure, IRB Authorization Agreements, policy, guidance and standard operating procedures (SOP) documents and IRB & RDC submissions and meetings.
7. Coordinates the collection of information necessary to assure compliance with annual reporting requirements. Provides necessary follow-up efforts, such as emails and phone calls, to assure timely completion. Provides leadership with reports and/or spreadsheets reflecting non-compliance with the reporting requirements.
8. Creates, updates and maintains relevant centralized tracking mechanisms for assigned projects as needed. Assures the accuracy of any regulatory documents received as well as ensuring all appropriate institutional signatures are obtained as required.
9. Provides support, guidance and coordination for HRPP project management and implementation across the organization, region and/or facility/entity. Customers include all staff levels within the organization, as well as external customers.

Must possess relevant knowledge as typically obtained through the completion of a bachelor’s degree in clinical research, compliance or other health-related field and at least two years of relevant work experience.

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

At FEMA, our mission is to help people before, during and after disasters, and every employee at FEMA has a role in emergency management. Every FEMA employee has regular and recurring emergency management responsibilities, though not every position requires routine deployment to disaster sites.

All positions are subject to recall around the clock for emergency management operations, which may require irregular work hours, work at locations other than the official duty station, and may include duties other than those specified in the employee's official position description.

Travel requirements in support of emergency operations may be extensive in nature (weeks to months), with little advance notice, and may require employees to relocate to emergency sites with physically austere and operationally challenging conditions. This announcement is for a position as a CORE (Cadre of On-Call Response/Recovery Employee).

CORE employees are full-time employees hired to directly support the response and recovery efforts related to disasters. Employees are hired under the Robert T. Stafford Act and are excluded from the provisions of title 5, United States Code, governing jobs in the competitive service.

They can be hired under a streamlined process instead of a competitive process. After three years of continuous service, Stafford Act employees may be granted competitive eligibility to apply for permanent full-time positions at FEMA.

Foundever 's NSOS Operational Efficiency team is scaling its Bill-to-Pay (BTP) Margin Recovery initiative — a structured analytical programme that identifies where Gross Margin (GM) is being lost at the account level and turns those findings into operational actions that drive measurable GM improvement across the EMEA region.
We are hiring a Business Analysts to extend coverage across the EMEA portfolio, supporting our goal of reviewing 50 accounts by the end of H2 2026.
The core of the role is a repeatable four-step process: (1) build an optimal BTP baseline for each account using financial performance data; (2) diagnose the gaps between that baseline and actual operational results, quantifying the GM opportunity by root cause; (3) translate findings into clear, prioritized recommendations and hand them off to Operations or Account Management for execution; and (4) track the evolution of each gap month-over-month to measure whether corrective actions are closing the performance shortfall.
You will not own the execution of corrective actions — that responsibility sits with Operations. Your role is to be the analytical engine behind the initiative: detecting, quantifying, communicating, and monitoring until each gap is resolved or escalated.

BTP Analysis & Gap Detection
For each assigned account, build a BTP baseline from financial performance data and WFM inputs to establish the optimal labour cost scenario.
Compare the optimal scenario based on the assumptions used for pricing against actual results (Theoretical Production, Actual, and Invoiced) to identify and size performance gaps by root cause: e.g. unplanned absenteeism, non-productive time, scheduling adherence failures, unbillable hours cap impact, internal shrinkage deviations, etc
Quantify the GM opportunity associated with each gap driver, at both the individual account level and aggregated across the portfolio.
Maintain a throughput of approximately 10 account analyses per Business Analyst every two weeks, consistent with the team's EMEA scaling roadmap.
Findings Communication & Operational Handoff
Translate analytical findings into structured, prioritized output (findings, root causes, recommended actions, estimated GM impact) formatted for handoff to Operations and Account Management.
Present conclusions clearly to non-technical stakeholders, focusing on the 'so what' — what needs to change, who owns it, and what the financial benefit of closing the gap is.
Coordinate with Operations and Account Management to validate findings and ensure recommended actions are operationally feasible before sign-off.
Monthly Follow-Up & Evolution Tracking
For accounts in active monitoring, track month-over-month BTP performance versus the established baseline to assess whether corrective actions are delivering the expected improvement.
Identify root-cause gaps that are improving, stagnating, or worsening, and escalate unresolved or recurring issues to the Director of Operational Efficiency with supporting evidence.
Maintain updated account records that document gap status, action ownership, and GM impact realised to date.
Process Consistency
Apply the team's standardized BTP methodology consistently across all assigned accounts and countries, ensuring comparability of findings across the EMEA portfolio.
Flag where data availability, data quality, or system limitations are constraining analysis accuracy, and contribute to the team's ongoing effort to improve data access and analytical automation.
What you need in order to be successful

2–4 years of experience in business analysis, workforce management analytics, financial operations analysis, or a related field — ideally within a BPO, contact center, or outsourced services environment.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
Proven experience working with financial performance data (P&L, margin, cost of labour) and operational metrics to generate actionable insight.
Technical Skills
Advanced Excel skills: structured analysis, financial modelling, pivot tables, formulas.
Solid understanding of workforce management concepts: shrinkage (internal and external), AUX/activity codes, scheduling adherence, login compliance, billable vs. paid hours.
Ability to work with WFM platform data exports (e.g. IEX) and account-level financial performance reports to build and validate BTP scenarios.
Comfortable working with incomplete, inconsistent, or manually compiled source data — able to apply structured judgement to reconcile discrepancies and document assumptions.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and root-cause-diagnosis mindset: able to move from a raw dataset to a clear, prioritized narrative about where margin is being lost and why.
Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to present complex financial and operational findings to non-technical stakeholders without requiring translation.
Organized and accountable: comfortable managing a recurring portfolio of accounts on a fixed monthly cadence, with clear documentation of status and progress.
Collaborative and assertive: able to work with Operations and Account Management to validate and land recommendations, without assuming ownership of their execution.
Languages
Fluent English required (written and spoken) — primary language for all reporting and stakeholder communication.
Additional French is a plus.
The work environment
A central role in a EMEA COO-sponsored, high-visibility initiative with direct, measurable impact on EMEA Gross Margin performance.
Exposure to senior cross-functional stakeholders across Operations, Account Management, and Finance.
A structured methodology to work within, with scope to help shape the team's evolution toward data automation and scalable analytics.
Career development within a growing analytics function at one of the world's leading customer experience companies.

The VA has adopted Core Values and Characteristics that apply universally across the Department. The five Core Values define "who we are," our culture, and how we care for Veterans, their families and other beneficiaries. The Values are Integrity, Commitment, Advocacy, Respect and Excellence ("I CARE").

That's why we created the Technical Career Field (TCF) Program - one of the largest training programs at VA. TCF positions equip professionals (including veterans) with the specialized knowledge they need to support the delivery of quality health care for our Nation's veterans.

The TCF career fields represent those technical fields where VA-specific knowledge and experience is desirable for success in the field. Individuals selected follow a formal training plan for two years during which they are trained, coached, and supervised by a preceptor.

Our transmission grid is the backbone of the region's energy economy, and keeping it strong requires continuous evolution. As a Senior Business Analyst in our Business Transformation and Process teams, you will play a pivotal role in this mission.

Rather than just managing processes, you will actively shape the physical and digital future of our grid.

This role is a high-visibility, high-impact opportunity where you will stand at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and organizational transformation, leading cross-functional teams to turn strategic goals into operational success.

As a Business Analyst, you will: Lead High-Impact, Cross-Functional Initiatives Head collaborative teams of multi-disciplinary experts to evaluate, shape, and execute complex business and infrastructure proposals. You will serve as the driving force behind projects from early-stage concepts to successful, long-term implementation.

Drive Prosci-Aligned Change Management Design and execute comprehensive organizational change strategies utilizing the industry-standard Prosci methodology. You will build and implement tailored plans for training, communication, and coaching to minimize disruption and ensure team buy-in across departmental lines.

Design and Reengineer Business Processes Serve as a trusted advisor in analyzing workflows, identifying operational bottlenecks, and designing modern, technology-enabled processes. Your work will directly enhance organizational efficiency, resource utilization, and decision-making capabilities.

You will provide critical insights to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget.

Direct End-to-End Project and Portfolio Execution Take ownership of project milestones, schedules, and deliverables. You will seamlessly integrate active initiatives into the broader organizational portfolio and develop performance metrics to track and evaluate success over time.

Coach and Advise Leadership at All Levels Provide expert guidance and coaching to managers and senior executives to build strong leadership sponsorship for strategic transitions. You will empower leaders to effectively guide their teams through complex organizational shifts.

Integrate Cutting-Edge Technology Solutions Collaborate with technology teams to identify, adopt, and integrate modern software applications and systems. You will ensure that digital tools are seamlessly incorporated into daily workflows to support grid operations and physical infrastructure projects.

Champion Stakeholder Engagement and Influence Build consensus, resolve conflicts, and cultivate collaborative relationships across the agency and with external partners. You will present compelling, data-driven findings to executives, persuading decision-makers to adopt solutions that align with the region's energy strategy.

As part of our Revenue Operations Technology team, the Salesforce Business Analyst will serve as a strategic liaison between global business business units and the Salesforce platform team, reporting directly to the Salesforce Product Owner.

In this role, you will lead cross-functional requirement gathering, process optimization, and value-mapping initiatives to ensure the Salesforce ecosystem drives measurable operational efficiency and global revenue growth.

You will partner closely with international stakeholders to streamline disparate processes, translate complex business needs into rigorous user stories, and ensure our solutions remain agile and scalable.

By bridging the gap between business strategy and execution, you will directly influence the corporate Salesforce roadmap, optimize global KPI reporting, and identify cutting-edge opportunities for autonomous AI automation.

Global Requirement Gathering: Lead cross-functional discovery workshops with global business teams and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs); translate complex business needs into refined user stories, acceptance criteria, and comprehensive process maps.
Process Optimization & Governance: Analyze, design, and streamline global business workflows within Salesforce to eliminate manual data redundancy, increase sales and support productivity, and establish robust data governance.

Enterprise Integration Alignment: Partner with business and technical teams to research, document, and validate Salesforce enhancements that intersect with enterprise platforms, specifically SAP S/4HANA.
Stakeholder Alignment & Consensus: Document and present technical solutions, business cases, and workflow changes to executive stakeholders to secure alignment, drive platform adoption, and gain formal sign-offs.
Testing, Validation & Training: Support the broader QA and project implementation teams by validating solution designs against original business requirements, participating in UAT, and crafting foundational training materials.

Salesforce Core Experience: 5+ years of dedicated experience as a Business Analyst within an enterprise-level Salesforce.com environment (Sales, Service, or Experience Clouds).
Enterprise Platform Exposure: Proven experience gathering requirements and mapping data flows for complex multi-system integrations, with direct experience involving SAP S/4HANA highly preferred.
Business Process Engineering: Demonstrated mastery in business process mapping, UI/UX gathering, and aligning disparate global teams on unified, streamlined workflows.
Agile & Technical Literacy: Deep experience working inside Agile/Scrum delivery frameworks, with high proficiency in Jira, Confluence, and collaborative documentation suites (Google Workspace/MS 365).
Consultative Soft Skills: Exceptional communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills; a proven ability to confidently ask critical questions, challenge status-quo workflows, and "bulletproof" proposed designs.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management Information Systems (MIS), Computer Science, or a related field.

At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!
Identity & Access Management Analyst
Join our dedicated 3-person Identity and Access Management (IAM) team within our broader technology department. In this role, you will work cross-functionally across Security, HR Ops, Privacy, and IT to manage critical access and secure resources enterprise-wide. We foster a healthy, transparent, and highly collaborative environment where you can work with state-of-the-art tech and leverage our AI investments to innovate in the IAM space.
As an Identity & Access Management Analyst you will take ownership of the day-to-day disciplines that govern how colleagues access the systems they need.

Working directly within the wider IT Operations and Identity & Access Management function, you will run the joiner, mover, and leaver processes, handle incoming access requests, administer privileged access, and support access reviews and audit evidence that keep us compliant.

Your efforts will directly shape how quickly and securely our team members get the access required to do their best work.
In this hands-on operational role, you will quickly broaden your scope into application onboarding, connecting new tools with Single Sign-On (SSO) and automated user provisioning (SCIM). You will collaborate closely with IT Operations, Security, and application owners across the business, all while receiving support from senior team members on more complex work.
What You’ll Be Doing
Access Administration & Ticketing: Serve as the operational contact for IAM ticketing, managing end-to-end user access lifecycles, including ticketing queues, approvals, and access provisioning, while driving process improvements through automation.
Guide Joiner, Mover & Leaver Journeys: Partner with teams to ensure colleagues have smooth, timely access on day one and that permissions are updated or removed seamlessly as roles change or people move on.
Lifecycle Management: Partner closely with HR Ops on employee and contractor onboarding and offboarding, flexibly adapting to frequent last-minute changes in start dates or employment scope.
Application Onboarding & Configuration: Perform basic technical configurations when integrating new SaaS platforms and tools, including setting up Single Sign-On (SSO), defining access groups, and establishing initial authorization levels.
Stakeholder & Vendor Engagement: Collaborate directly with internal system owners and third-party vendors to troubleshoot access issues, configure SAML integrations, and manage platform permissions.
Manage Elevated Permissions: Administer privileged and administrative access, ensuring elevated permissions are time-bound, justified, and regularly reviewed.
Maintain Reliable Identity Data: Govern group memberships, access roles, and HR system integrations to ensure identity data remains accurate across systems.
Support Audit Readiness : Run periodic access reviews and compile documentation for audit requests (such as SOC 2) for systems in scope.
Solve Access Challenges : Support colleagues when access issues arise, looking into root causes to build lasting, friendly solutions rather than short-term fixes.
Automate & Streamline: Connect applications to Microsoft Entra ID using standards like SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SCIM where supported. Follow clear, manual processes with proper checks where SCIM isn't supported, and look for repetitive tasks that can be simplified or automated.

Identity Experience: Background in an IT or Identity & Access Management role using a modern identity provider. Experience with Microsoft Entra ID is a plus, but experience with a comparable platform is welcome.
Care for the Details : Practical experience handling joiner, mover, and leaver work, access requests, or user administration, with an appreciation for why accurate access matters to people’s day-to-day work.
Familiar with Modern Security : Comfortable with access controls like multi-factor authentication and conditional access, as well as modern sign-in options—from one-time codes to authenticator apps, passkeys, and certificates—and why some offer stronger protection.
Security & Audit Mindset : Comfortable viewing access through a security and compliance lens, understanding the value of clear evidence and audit trails.
Single Sign-On (SSO) Knowledge : Practical experience configuring enterprise SSO alongside vendors or app owners—backed by an understanding of SAML and OAuth 2.0—or a strong desire to learn them.
Curious Problem-Solver : Able to independently analyze and troubleshoot sign-in flows to pinpoint integration issues before escalating.
Automation-Oriented : Exposure to automated user provisioning (SCIM), or an understanding of the concepts with an eagerness to build on them. Comfortable with scripting or excited to learn.
Clear & Empathetic Communicator : Able to communicate thoughtfully with colleagues across different departments—whether explaining why a request was declined or walking an application owner through a setup.
Methodical & Mindful: Thoughtful and precise in your approach, recognizing that identity work carries a low tolerance for mistakes and directly impacts the team experience.

About Get Covered and Revyse
Revyse helps multifamily operators discover the best vendor partners, manage contracts and compliance, and reduce financial risk. Our platform turns vendor data into a strategic advantage - and our newest compliance product is changing how property management companies onboard, verify, and support vendors.

We’re a fast-moving post-acquisition startup with a big vision: overhaul how operators and suppliers work together. Founded by industry experts and backed by leading multifamily investors, Revyse is growing quickly - and we’re looking for someone who loves building order from the chaos of growth.
How We Build
We don’t run sprints. Our company prioritizes the work together, and Engineers work in cross-functional pods. We leverage AI to draft most of our tickets, and Engineers write some of their own. There is no process layer standing between an idea and the code. That model moves fast, and it is only as good as the context feeding it. A confident, well-structured ticket that is wrong about how insurance requirements vary by trade can be painful. This role’s north star is to fix that.
You are not here to assign work or gate it, you're are here to make sure the right work is the easiest work to pick up. Your influence comes entirely from the quality of your context and the clarity of your case, which is either the best part of this job or the wrong job for you.
The domain has depth and complexity. Insurance requirements vary by trade, scope of work, and state. Compliance rules vary by customer. You will not be able to reason about our data without learning the domain, but don't worry - we'll give you time to learn it.

1. Context & Documentation
If AI drafts the tickets, the quality of what gets built is decided by the context it receives. That context is what you’ll optimize.
Understand and write down how the platform actually behaves today - the workflows, the exception paths, the rules, and the undocumented behavior currently living in people's heads.
Build and maintain the reference material that our AI tooling and our engineers pull from, and keep it accurate as the product changes. Stale documentation now produces bad tickets and bad code automatically, at scale.
Review tickets and specs against reality before anyone builds them. This is the part that matters most: AI-generated work is confidently wrong exactly where it costs the most - edge cases, compliance rules, customer-specific commitments, anything that is not in the repo or the training data.
Capture acceptance criteria, edge cases, failure behavior, and explicit non-goals so a pod can pick something up and build it without a meeting.
2. Product Data & Analysis
You’ll answer product questions with SQL against real data. Things like usage, throughput, drop-off, exception rates, workflow completion, turnaround times.
Quantify shipped work. Did it move the number it was supposed to move, and by how much.
Build and maintain the recurring reporting the pods rely on, so nobody rebuilds the same query every month.
Surface what nobody asked about. Note the distribution, the outliers, and the places where two numbers should reconcile and don't. The anomaly is usually the real finding.
3. Prototyping to Communicate
A working prototype settles an argument that a document might extend. You will build them constantly, and then engineers will rebuild the real thing.
Use AI tooling to build rough, working versions of an idea. A screen, a script, a query tool, a data view, so the team can react to something concrete.
Build small internal tools for yourself and the team where doing so is faster than asking for one.
Hand intent to engineers clearly. Your prototype is the argument, not the implementation.

3+ years as a business analyst, technical analyst, product analyst, data analyst, or in product operations, working closely with engineers.
Strong SQL. You write your own queries against a real schema, you understand what a join is doing to your row count, and you sanity-check your results before presenting them.
You can read a database schema and work out how a product behaves from it.
You already work with AI as a daily tool, not an experiment. You know how to structure context so output is reliable, you iterate on prompts rather than accepting the first answer, and you know when a model is confidently wrong and you check.
You can build a rough working thing with AI assistance. Not production code. A prototype good enough that people can react to it instead of imagining it.
You write clearly. In a setup like ours, written clarity is not a soft skill. It is the input that determines what gets built.
Analytical honesty. You quantify rather than characterize, you name your assumptions, and when numbers don't reconcile you stop and investigate instead of shipping the chart.
Comfort operating without process scaffolding, and comfort saying “not this week, here's why” when three people want the same hour.
Bonus: B2B SaaS with enterprise customers, compliance- or workflow-heavy products, Python for analysis, or experience maintaining documentation that AI tooling depends on.

Descripción del trabajo
Data Management Senior Analyst es responsable de gestionar la calidad y confiabilidad de la información correspondientes a los clientes de su portafolio, mediante la ejecución, análisis y mejora continua de los procesos asociados al reporte de información de Buró. Así mismo, brinda acompañamiento a los clientes en caso de reportes para Data Alternativa y/o Data Consentida, asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares definidos para estos datos.
El cargo combina capacidades analíticas, de gestión y de relacionamiento con clientes para garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad, identificar oportunidades de mejora, optimizar procesos e impulsar iniciativas que promuevan la incorporación y el aprovechamiento de nuevas fuentes de datos que fortalezcan el negocio. De igual forma, contribuye a ofrecer una experiencia positiva a los clientes, promoviendo procesos eficientes y relaciones de largo plazo.

s.h: El rol integra tres dimensiones clave
s.t:
Gestión: administración y seguimiento de los procesos asociados a los datos, asegurando la calidad de la información y el acompañamiento a los clientes.
Analítica: análisis de información para identificar desviaciones, tendencias, causas raíz y oportunidades de mejora.
Estratégica: generación e implementación de iniciativas que fortalezcan la calidad, el aprovechamiento de los datos, la automatización y la experiencia del cliente. Así mismo, identificar oportunidades para ampliar la información o los datos que reportan los clientes, promoviendo la incorporación de nuevas fuentes, atributos y reportes que generen mayor valor para el negocio

· Gestión integral del portafolio de clientes asignado, asegurando la actualización oportuna y la calidad de la información reportada al Buró, y cuando aplique, de Data Alternativa y Data Consentida.
· Seguimiento a los indicadores de calidad y desempeño del portafolio asignado, identificando riesgos y oportunidades de mejora.
· Análisis de desviaciones, causas raíz y planes de acción para fortalecer la calidad de la información y la continuidad del servicio a los clientes.
· Preparación de informes y tableros de seguimiento para las sesiones con clientes, facilitando el monitoreo de indicadores y la toma de decisiones.
· Gestión y seguimiento de requerimientos, incidentes y casos escalados, garantizando su trazabilidad y resolución oportuna.
· Validación y actualización de procesos, reglas de negocio y lineamientos asociados a la gestión de la información, proponiendo mejoras cuando se identifiquen oportunidades.
· Implementación de iniciativas de mejora continua, automatización y optimización, orientadas a fortalecer la eficiencia de los procesos y la experiencia del cliente.
· Identificación de oportunidades para ampliar o fortalecer el uso de la información, promoviendo el aprovechamiento de nuevas fuentes de datos cuando aplique.
· Generación de análisis e información de valor que apoyen la toma de decisiones para correcciones por parte de los clientes cuando se requiera.
· Acompañamiento y asesoría especializada a los clientes, promoviendo el cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad, los lineamientos operativos y la correcta gestión del ciclo de vida del dato.

About DoorDash
At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers.

We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

What do we do?
Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.
We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

Are you a passionate problem-solver with a knack for deciphering financial and commercial data to uncover real business impact? Driven by the desire to shape growth strategies through actionable insights? If so, we invite you to join us as a Business Analyst.
At Paddle, we are building an analytical culture that empowers every team member to harness data for smarter decision-making. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in driving customer profitability, improving gross margins, and optimizing our cost structures. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will turn complex financial data into insights that directly influence revenue growth, pricing strategies, and operational efficiency.

Revenue & Pricing Analysis: Evaluate pricing initiatives and commercial strategies, modeling scenarios to help optimize revenue generation and measure business impact.
Profitability & Cost Optimization: Analyze key drivers of customer profitability, margins, and cost of sales to highlight opportunities for efficiency, cost reduction, and growth.
Core Data Analytics: Perform in-depth analytical work to uncover trends, translating complex datasets into clear, practical recommendations—not just buzzwords.
Data Alignment & Infrastructure: Partner with Data Engineering and analytics teams to define requirements and ensure efficient data models are built for commercial and financial reporting.
Dashboards & Reporting: Build, maintain, and enhance BI dashboards and visualisations to ensure critical metrics remain visible, accurate, and actionable across teams.
Cross-Functional Execution: Work alongside stakeholders across Finance, Product, Go-To-Market, and Operations to translate analytical insights into action and track their long-term impact.
Analytics Culture & Process: Advocate for data-informed decision-making across the business, helping refine analytical processes and improving data accuracy over time.

s.h: We'd love to hear from you if you are
s.t:
An Analytical Professional: Proven track record in Data or Business Analysis, ideally within a tech or SaaS environment. Experience in finance, pricing, margin analysis, or payments is a plus.
Technically Proficient: Skilled in SQL, Google Sheets, and BI/visualisation platforms (e.g., Omni, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI).
A Creative Problem-Solver: Possess an inventive, resourceful approach to tackling ambiguous data challenges, embracing tough problems head-on rather than backing down.
A Critical Thinker: Able to break down complex commercial models and translate detailed data into clear, high-impact recommendations.
An Effective Communicator: Skilled at presenting insights clearly to stakeholders across functions and building strong collaborative relationships.
Detail-Oriented & Resilient: Thorough with data accuracy, precise in your calculations, and excited about navigating a dynamic environment with complex challenges.

s.h: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
s.t:
At Parexel , we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.
Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel , contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.
About Parexel
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.

We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Business Analyst, you will drive strategic improvements across clinical research operations by analyzing complex business processes, gathering and translating stakeholder requirements, and designing solutions that enhance efficiency and compliance.

This position plays a key role in process optimization, system implementation, requirements management, and operational transformation. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams across clinical operations, follow industry-standard methodologies, and contribute to strategic initiatives from planning through execution.
Responsibilities include leading comprehensive business analysis activities, conducting process improvement initiatives, designing solutions that meet business requirements, and mentoring team members. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Business Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research operations and technology integration.

Lead comprehensive analysis of business needs, processes, and workflows across clinical research functions
Conduct thorough requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders at all levels and translate complex business needs into clear, detailed, and actionable requirements documentation
Develop use cases, user stories, and functional specifications that accurately reflect business requirements and validate requirements with stakeholders to ensure completeness and accuracy
Analyze current state business processes to identify inefficiencies and gaps, document existing workflows using process mapping techniques, and design future state processes that optimize efficiency, quality, and compliance
Develop recommendations for process standardization and automation, perform cost-benefit analyses for proposed process changes, and measure and report on the effectiveness of implemented improvements
Collaborate with technical teams to design solutions that meet business requirements and develop functional specifications and design documents for system implementations
Support the development and execution of test plans and test cases, validate that implemented solutions meet business requirements and quality standards, and develop training materials and support documentation for end users
Lead business analysis activities for medium to large-scale projects, develop project scope and deliverables, create and manage business analysis work plans and timelines, and identify and manage risks related to requirements and solution implementation
Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across clinical operations, facilitate communication between business units and technology teams, and present analysis findings and recommendations to stakeholders at various levels
Mentor junior business analysts and share best practices, stay current with industry trends and regulatory changes affecting clinical research, and identify opportunities for innovation in clinical processes and systems

Paperless Environments ® has been revolutionizing document management and accounts payable workflow automation since 2005. Our innovative software solutions are used by over 2,000 customers across all 50 states and in 5 other countries.

Our software enables customers to efficiently manage their accounts payable processing through workflow automation, document management and accounting system integration. We pride ourselves on delivering an exceptional customer experience and maintaining the highest level of customer satisfaction.

As a Technical Product Business Analyst at Paperless Environments , you will play a pivotal role in our product team. This senior-level role works closely with Product Management and Development to define product requirements and ensure smooth Agile execution of our SaaS solutions.

You will bridge the gap between business needs and technical implementation – translating stakeholder needs into clear requirements, grooming and prioritizing the product backlog, and collaborating with developers throughout the development lifecycle.

The Technical Product BA ensures that new features and enhancements are well-defined, delivered on time, and meet our high standards for quality and customer satisfaction. You will also be an Agile process champion, helping the team maintain efficiency and continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment

User Story Definition
Translate business and user needs into detailed backlog items with clear acceptance criteria and use cases.
Ensure that requirements are documented in a clear, concise manner, and are readily understood by the development team.

Proactively manage and groom the product backlog, keeping a well-prioritized list of user stories and epics ready for development.
Work closely with the Product Manager to prioritize backlog items aligned with product roadmap and customer value and prepare user stories for sprint planning (including story point estimation and dependencies).

Collaborate daily with Development, QA, Product Design, and User Assistance teams to ensure proposed solutions are technically feasible and align with business goals.
Act as a liaison between non-technical stakeholders and the technical team, clarifying requirements and answering questions during sprints to prevent misunderstandings or delays.

Take an active role in Agile ceremonies – attend daily stand-ups, lead backlog refinement sessions, lead/participate in sprint planning, and lead/contribute to sprint reviews and retrospectives.
Help drive smooth Agile execution by providing insight and feedback during these ceremonies and ensuring the team adheres to Scrum best practices.

Define and write acceptance criteria for all user stories to guide the testing process.
Work with QA to develop test plans and ensure thorough coverage of requirements.
Assist in user acceptance testing (UAT) and actively validate that delivered features meet the specified requirements and acceptance criteria. When necessary, help triage and verify fixes for defects or support issues during the sprint.

Maintain comprehensive documentation of product requirements, process workflows, and release notes for new features.
Utilize Atlassian Confluence (and similar tools) to document functional and non-functional specifications, decisions, and knowledge transfer information for internal use.
Ensure that all documentation is up-to-date and accessible to relevant stakeholders for knowledge sharing and training purposes.

Serve as a subject-matter expert on our products.
Provide clear and timely communication to all members of the team about feature progress.
Conduct knowledge transfers to train internal teams (Customer Support, Customer Success, Sales, etc.) on new product features and workflows to ensure organizational readiness for product launches.

Coordinate with Development and external partners when integrating with third-party services or APIs.

At Clover Health, we’re focused on improving the health of our members by leveraging technology and data-driven insights to provide personalized, high-quality care. As a Medicare Advantage plan, we aim to empower our members by helping them navigate the complexities of healthcare and live healthier lives. We are passionate about making healthcare easier, more affordable, and more accessible for everyone.
We are looking for an AI-forward Business Analyst, Clinical & Reimbursement Policy to serve as the strategic bridge between regulatory requirements and automated execution. In this high-impact role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of Clover’s clinical and reimbursement policies, ensuring they are accurately interpreted, regularly updated, and seamlessly integrated into our claims environment.
You will act as a primary Subject Matter Expert (SME), translating complex Medicare guidelines—including National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs)—into actionable logic. You will also play a critical role in vendor management, partnering with external vendors to enhance policy oversight.

Your mission is to accelerate Clover's transition toward a high-precision payment ecosystem where monitoring and research are highly automated, ensuring clinical and reimbursement policies are seamlessly and accurately operationalized.
As a Business Analyst, Clinical & Reimbursement Policy, you will:
Policy Lifecycle & Compliance: Own the accountability for the development and maintenance of clinical and reimbursement policies, ensuring perfect alignment with CMS regulations.
Medicare Regulatory SME: Serve as the authority on Medicare guidelines, specifically interpreting and operationalizing NCDs, LCDs, and general national coding guidelines.
Strategic Vendor Management: Serve as the primary oversight for external vendor performance regarding policy monitoring and accuracy. Hold partners to world-class standards through data-driven performance reviews and collaborative workflow design.
AI-Driven Evolution: Lead the implementation of AI initiatives to automate the monitoring of reimbursement policies. Utilize advanced LLMs (such as Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT) to conduct regular deep research on ongoing industry trends.
System Integration: Partner with the Configuration and Data Science teams to ensure that clinical and reimbursement policy intent is perfectly synchronized with technical adjudication.
Cross-Functional Influence: Act as the strategic bridge between Clinical, Claims, and Compliance teams to ensure a unified vision of payment excellence.

s.h: Success in this role looks like
s.t:
By the end of your initial 90-day period: You will have established a recurring review framework and a comprehensive project plan for Clover's clinical and reimbursement policy library to ensure baseline quality and strict adherence to clinical guidelines.
By 6 months: You will have ensured that all existing clinical and reimbursement policies are current and up to date, reflecting the latest regulatory requirements. You will also have implemented an AI-forward oversight framework that utilizes advanced research tools and early-detection monitoring to enhance accuracy within our adjudication systems. You will be actively leveraging AI tools like Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT to perform deep-dive research on industry trends and regulatory updates.
Continued success: You will lead the evolution of Clover’s policy management into a proactive strategic powerhouse. By championing automated monitoring and data-driven research, you will ensure Clover’s payment ecosystem achieves market-leading precision and technological sophistication.

You have 5+ years of experience in healthcare claims, configuration, or reimbursement policy, with a heavy emphasis on Medicare Advantage.
You are extremely AI-forward and are passionate about how emerging technologies and LLMs (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, etc.) can be applied to drive operational precision in research and monitoring.
You are a Medicare expert with a proven track record of interpreting and operationalizing complex clinical policies, NCDs, and LCDs.
You have experience managing vendor relationships at a strategic level, ensuring external partners meet rigorous performance standards.

You are familiar with enterprise claims engines and understand how these systems interact to drive adjudication accuracy.
