Who We Are
Launchpad Technologies Inc. is a global technology partner connecting top talent with high-impact projects across North America and beyond. We specialize in Staff Augmentation and product development, helping companies scale with agility while empowering professionals to grow in meaningful, remote-first environments.

We are looking for a Technical Business Analyst specializing in system and API integrations to join our Professional Services team.
This is not a traditional Business Analyst role focused primarily on backlog management, user stories, or application configuration. Your focus will be integration discovery and solution design.
You will work across different client environments, platforms, and implementation projects to determine how systems should communicate, what data needs to move between them, and how the integration should be designed.
You will be expected to quickly understand unfamiliar systems, research their integration capabilities, analyze API documentation, define data mappings and transformation requirements, identify technical constraints, and design practical integration solutions.
You will not simply document what a customer asks for. We are looking for someone who can challenge assumptions, identify gaps, evaluate alternatives, and recommend how an integration should work.
Strong critical thinking, technical curiosity, and independent problem-solving are essential for success in this role.
Start date: September 2026
️Contract type: Independent Contractor + Indefinite Contract
Work hours: Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 4 PM PST
Work mode: 100% remote
What You’ll Be Doing
Own the discovery and solution design of system integrations across different customer and internal projects.
Analyze source and destination systems to understand how data should move between them.
Research unfamiliar applications independently, including reviewing publicly available technical and API documentation before client discovery sessions.
Lead technical discovery conversations with customers, implementation teams, developers, and other stakeholders.
Identify the appropriate APIs, endpoints, operations, data sources, and integration mechanisms required to solve each use case.
Define end-to-end integration flows, including how information is created, exchanged, transformed, validated, and synchronized across systems.
Create detailed source-to-target data mappings, including field relationships, data types, transformations, required values, defaults, validation rules, and exceptions.
Identify integration challenges such as mismatched identifiers, data dependencies, synchronization requirements, system limitations, and error scenarios.
Propose practical technical solutions rather than relying on customers or developers to determine how the integration should work.
Translate business integration needs into clear and actionable technical specifications that development teams can build from.
Collaborate with engineering, implementation, QA, and client teams throughout delivery to clarify requirements and protect the integrity of the integration design.
Support integration validation and troubleshooting when necessary.
Work across multiple systems, customers, and projects and adapt quickly to changing technical contexts
What You Need to Succeed
Must-haves
4+ years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst, Integration Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, Technical Consultant, Integration Consultant, or similar role.
Proven experience working on multiple system integration projects.
Experience taking integration requirements beyond discovery and contributing directly to integration solution design.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, web services, and system-to-system integrations.
Ability to confidently read and interpret API documentation.
Strong understanding of JSON and XML structures and data exchange concepts.
Experience creating detailed data mappings between source and target systems.
Understanding of data transformation, validation, synchronization, and error-handling concepts.
Working knowledge of SQL and the ability to use or interpret queries for data analysis, validation, or troubleshooting.
Ability to understand unfamiliar software systems and determine how their integration capabilities can be used to solve a business problem.
Experience gathering technical requirements directly from customers and translating them into specifications for development teams.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
Experience working directly with North American clients or distributed international teams.
Ability to work independently and take ownership without requiring detailed step-by-step direction.
Nice-to-haves
Experience using Postman or similar tools to inspect and test APIs.
Experience with ETL processes or file-based integrations such as FTP/SFTP.
Familiarity with OAuth, API keys, bearer tokens, and other common authentication approaches.
Experience troubleshooting API or data-integration issues.
Previous software development or engineering experience.
Experience with enterprise SaaS products or ERP ecosystems.
Exposure to systems such as Medius, SAP, Oracle, Epicor, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, or similar enterprise applications.
Experience with financial, procurement, Accounts Payable, or Spend Management platforms.
What Success Looks Like
You will be successful in this role when you can receive a new integration challenge, quickly understand the systems involved, perform meaningful research independently, conduct an efficient discovery session, identify the right questions and technical constraints, and turn that information into a solution that developers can confidently implement.
Over time, we expect you to become someone the team can trust to enter an unfamiliar integration scenario and figure it out.
You should be able to represent Launchpad confidently in customer and partner conversations, make sound technical recommendations within your area of responsibility, and move projects forward without requiring constant escalation or supervision.
What to Expect from Our Hiring Process
Introductory Conversation (60 minutes) : Meet with our Talent team to learn more about Launchpad, our culture, working conditions, and the role. We will also explore your professional background, career interests, and overall fit for the opportunity.
Final Interview (60 minutes) : Meet with our Director of Professional Services for a deeper discussion about your technical expertise, consulting experience, client-facing skills, and the value you could bring to Launchpad and our projects.
Follow-Up Conversation (Optional, 30 minutes) : An additional conversation may be scheduled to clarify specific topics, meet another member of the team, or further explore technical or project-related experience.

The Opportunity
Reporting to the Director of People Technology, this role will serve as a Delivery Lead and Principal Product Analyst for Okta's People Technology portfolio, focused on the Growth & Talent pod.

In this broad role, you will lead complex, multi-system initiatives spanning Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Performance, Learning, and Career Development.

You will serve as the crucial conduit between Product Management, Recruiting/Talent Acquisition leadership, Talent Management, and People Operations, driving technical execution against a prioritized backlog to align with Okta's strategic workforce goals.
What You'll Be Doing
Strategic Leadership: Technically scope and lead the delivery of multi-quarter, high-visibility, executive-sponsored projects across the Growth & Talent ecosystem (e.g., Greenhouse ATS integration & workflows, Cornerstone L&D platform optimization, and Workday Talent & Performance solutions).
Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the functional specialist and delivery lead for the Growth & Talent pod, specializing in talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, learning management, and career development technology integrations.
Core Systems Architecture & Integration: Partner with enterprise architects and delivery engineers to drive seamless end-to-end integrations across Greenhouse (Applicant Tracking System), Cornerstone (Learning & Experience Platform), and Workday (Talent, Performance, Skills, and Core HCM).
Backlog & Execution Management: Drive delivery against a prioritized backlog for aligned Talent Acquisition and Talent Management stakeholder groups, ensuring successful project execution from start to finish.
Agile & Scrum Execution: Operate actively in a Scrum framework—breaking down complex epics and business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable technical tasks while participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
Process Innovation & AI Enablement: Utilize functional and technical talent domain expertise to identify opportunities to optimize, automate, and innovate recruitment workflows, employee learning paths, and internal mobility through modern technology and AI capabilities.
Impediment Resolution: Proactively identify and resolve project-level risks, cross-system integration blockers, and requirement trade-offs with Talent Acquisition and Talent Management stakeholders to ensure on-time delivery.
Mentorship & Influence: Guide project teams through uncertainty, facilitate technical scoping workshops, and provide mentorship to junior analysts and developers.
Stakeholder Partnership: Act as the primary conduit between Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and technical delivery teams, owning and writing detailed functional requirements, business process flows, data mappings, and use cases.

This position is designated by the Air Force as a Test Designated Position (TDP) under the Air Force Civilian Drug Testing Program. As a mandatory requirement for employment in this TDP, the incumbent is (A) to refrain from use of illegal drugs and (B) if required, to submit to urinalysis testing.

The selectee must sign a statement acknowledging the position occupied is identified as a TDP. This position is emergency-essential. In the event of a crisis situation, the incumbent, or designated alternate, must continue to perform the Emergency Essential duties until relieved by proper authority.

The incumbent or the designated alternate may be required to take part in readiness exercises. This position cannot be vacated during national emergency or mobilization without seriously impairing the capability of the organization to function effectively.

This meets the criteria of an Emergency-Essential position and requires that the incumbent, or the designated alternate, be removed from any military recall status. Employee must sign DD Form 2365 as a condition of employment.

LAUTENBERG AMENDMENT: This position is covered by the Domestic Violence Misdemeanor Amendment (30 Sep 96) of the Gun Control Act (Lautenberg Amendment) of 1968. An individual convicted of a qualifying crime of domestic violence may not perform the duties of this position.

In order to qualify, you must meet the specialized experience requirements described in the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) Qualification Standards for General Schedule Positions, Administrative and Management Positions- Management and Program Analysis (0343).

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: Applicants must have at least one (1) year of specialized experience at the next lower grade GS-12, or equivalent in other pay systems.

Examples of specialized experience includes in-depth substantive knowledge of Joint Operation Planning and Execution System Planning Formats and Guidance and processes, joint programs, activities, missions, policies, and objectives and analytical and evaluative methods and techniques for assessing operational planning documents and systems.

Extensive knowledge of analysis principles, practices, and techniques required to perform studies, and develop recommendations on issues related to joint planning to improve planning concepts, resolve problems, and gain effectiveness and efficiency.

Knowledge of the mission, organization, and work processes of various programs and the relationships of administrative support activities to such missions is crucial to this knowledge and skills. As a senior planner, directs the Operations Plans Division program segment as it pertains to crisis planning/current operations.

Knowledge is applied in conducting studies, analyzing findings and making recommendations on the overall operations planning program as it pertains to long range planning and forecasting. This segment is highly complex and technical requiring extensive knowledge and experience.

This knowledge has a direct impact on the overall success of the Operations Directorate portion of the USCENTCOM mission. FEDERAL TIME-IN-GRADE (TIG) REQUIREMENT FOR GENERAL SCHEDULE (GS) POSITIONS: Merit promotion applicants must meet applicable time-in­-grade requirements to be considered eligible.

One year at the GS-12 level is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-13 level. TIG applies if you are in a current GS position or held a GS position within the previous 52 weeks.

NOTE: Applicants applying as VEOA candidates who are current GS civil service employees or are prior GS civil service employees within the past 52 weeks must also meet time-in-grade requirements.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (KSAs): Your qualifications will be evaluated on the basis of your level of knowledge, skills, abilities and/or competencies in the following areas: Substantive knowledge of Joint Operation Planning and Execution System Planning Formats and Guidance and processes, joint programs, activities, missions, policies, and objectives and analytical and evaluative methods and techniques for assessing operational planning documents and systems.

Expert knowledge of major joint programs, analysis principles, practices, and techniques required to perform studies, and develop recommendations on issues related to joint planning to improve planning concepts, resolve problems, gain effectiveness and efficiency, and goals/objectives for short/long range implementation.

Wide knowledge of analysis principles, practices and techniques required to perform studies and develop recommendations on issues related to joint planning to improve planning concepts, resolve problems and gain effectiveness and efficiency.

Knowledge and skill to analyze, develop, and evaluate detail plans, goals, and objectives for short- and long-range implementation of assigned programs.

Ability to prepare and deliver written and oral presentations such as extensive detailed reports, briefings, training sessions, consultations and strategy sessions with other staff service functions and activities to secure cooperation, resolve controversial matters, and convey information relative to proposed changes in assigned programs.

Ability to analyze incoming information and data pertaining to operations and plans detailing context actions required compliance issues and other critical aspects. PART-TIME OR UNPAID EXPERIENCE: Credit will be given for appropriate unpaid and or part-time work.

You must clearly identify the duties and responsibilities in each position held and the total number of hours per week.

VOLUNTEER WORK EXPERIENCE: Refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service Programs (i.e., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student and social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge and skills that can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

This position is located within the Administration, Business, Management, and Governance (ABMG) Directorate, Division of Administration. The Division oversees human capital management, administrative operations, and executive support functions. It is also responsible for strategic planning and budgeting related to administrative services.

This position serves as a Human Capital Specialist responsible for performing analytical and evaluative work that strengthens OCIO's human capital program. Major duties are listed at the full performance level (GS-13).

Major duties include but are not limited to: Perform analytical assignments to identify technical workflow issues, operational risks, and customer needs, recommending solutions that improve efficiency and consistency.

Support strategic human capital program by monitoring workforce trends, identifying competency gaps, tracking retirement and attrition patterns, and compiling information used by senior analysts in long-term planning.

Advise managers on Departmental HR policies, helping them understand impacts on the division operations and recommending updates to align with established procedures. Provide informed guidance and recommendations to organizational leadership on federal HR regulations, policies, and best practices.

Support communication between stakeholders to maintain shared understanding of human capital priorities, identifies workforce-related issues, and collaborates with leadership to ensure timely resolution.

Compile information on hiring activity, staffing levels, attrition, and awards to support senior analysts in more complex forecasting and trend analysis.

Handle sensitive and pre-decisional information, including grievances, reassignments, and reorganizations, ensuring confidentiality in accordance with privacy, records management, and labor-management policy.

Maintain and monitor employee records, promotions, quality step increase recommendations, awards, corrective actions, employee development, training, counseling or termination of employees.
Specialized Experience is the experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities (KSA's) to perform the duties of the position successfully, and that is typically in or related to the position to be filled.

To be creditable, specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level. For GS-12, applicants must have 52 weeks of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, GS-11, in the Federal Service.

Qualifying specialized experience for GS-12 includes (applicants must meet 3 of the 4 following specialized experience statements): Experience analyzing programs and business operations within a single office or program to improve efficiency, workflows, and administrative processes.

Experience reviewing administrative procedures and program activities within assigned functions to identify issues and recommend solutions. Experience designing and conducting moderate-scope studies of business processes and systems, including data collection, analysis, and improvement recommendations.

Experience coordinating multiple projects and priorities for a division or office, synthesizing information, and preparing clear recommendations for managers. For GS-13, applicants must have 52 weeks of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level, GS-12, in the Federal Service.

Qualifying specialized experience for GS-13 includes (applicants must meet ALL of the following specialized experience statements): Experience leading cross-functional analyses that improve efficiency and effectiveness across programs or organizations, and overseeing solution implementation and results.

Experience evaluating and modernizing administrative procedures across multiple functional areas or offices, identifying systemic issues and advising senior leadership on policy or process changes.

Experience developing and applying advanced qualitative and quantitative methods and performance measures to assess organizational effectiveness and drive enterprise-level improvements.

Experience coordinating and prioritizing multiple enterprise initiatives for senior leaders, synthesizing diverse inputs, and producing decision-ready briefings that shape strategy and resource allocation.

The following are the duties of this position at the full working level. If this vacancy includes more than one grade and you are selected at a lower grade level, you will have the opportunity to learn to perform these duties and receive training to help you grow in this position.

Serves as project manager for the planning, development, coordination, and implementation of customer relations and continuity of operations projects that impact multiple organizations and/or IRS locations.

In this role, he/she provides support to the Senior Project Manager to administer and safeguard data collection for emergency and incident management impacting up to 80,000 thousand IRS employees.

Provides key input to leadership and team members and ensures all project tracking and documentation aspects are completed accurately, thoroughly, and timely.

Responsible for developing and managing the initial design of new program activities, and may coordinate and consult with Department of Treasury, FEMA, Homeland Security, and private industry sources.

Represents the IRS interests and coordinates the impact of the projects with employees and managers in all affected areas within the Service and with individuals and organizations outside of the Service. Responsible for updating project control systems used by Office of Continuity Operations.

As needed, conducts reviews of projects/programs with Office of Continuity Operations scope impacting performance measures, incident and emergency management standards and records management assigned to others within the business units to ensure compliance with all customer requirements.

Utilizes project management skills in the accomplishment of work assignments.

This includes addressing such areas as compliance/integration with organizational goals and objectives; workload and workflow issues; impact to staffing levels; timelines; coordination with IT (Information Technology), and identification and coordination with all other program specialties involved in the implementation, execution, and tracking phases.

Identifies all problems encountered pertaining to resource, funding, and/or project requirement issues. Responsible for the planning, development, coordination, implementation, and assessment of assigned Office of Continuity Operations projects/programs.

Proactively consults with Senior Project Manager, business unit managers and leadership to identify/define customer needs and requirements relative to employee compliance with safety, security, incident and emergency management protocol. STANDARD POSITION DESCRIPTIONS (SPD): PD99066 Visit the IRS SPD Library to access the position descriptions.
Federal experience is not required. Experience may have been gained in the public sector, private sector or through Volunteer Service. One year of experience refers to full-time work; part-timework is considered on a prorated basis.

To ensure full credit for your work experience, please indicate dates of employment by month/day/year, and indicate number of hours worked per week, on your resume. You must meet the following requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE GS-13 Level: You must have one year of specialized experience at a level of difficulty and responsibility equivalent to the GS-12 grade level in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position includes Experience in leading project assignments that required a wide range of analytical and evaluative methods and techniques, both qualitative and quantitative, to accomplish projects or studies broad in scope and magnitude.

Experience with the application of a range of laws, policies, regulations, and precedents applicable to the segment(s) of the Service's program affected by the assigned project or study; Experience with management principles and processes to perform project management duties to effectively coordinate and integrate project objectives and recommendations with key line and/or staff functions of the Service; Experience with oral and written communication.

Experience editing and proofreading using multiple content management systems.

AND You must also meet the following requirement(s): TIME AFTER COMPETITIVE APPOINTMENT (TACA): By the closing date (or if this is an open continuous announcement, by the cut-off date) specified in this job announcement, current civilian employees must have completed at least 90 days of federal civilian service since their latest non-temporary appointment from a competitive referral certificate, known as time after competitive appointment.

For this requirement, a competitive appointment is one where you applied to and were appointed from an announcement open to "All US Citizens" TIME IN GRADE (TIG): For positions above the GS-05, applicants must meet applicable time-in-­grade requirements to be considered eligible.

One year (52 weeks) at the next lower grade level is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the grade you are applying for. For positions at the GS-05, you cannot advance to the GS-05 if you have held a GS-02 in the past 52 weeks. There is no TIG restriction for GS-02, 03 or 04 positions.

For more information on qualifications please refer to OPM's Qualifications Standards.

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.
With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.
Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement.

We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

You'll join our GTM Systems team, which owns the systems LangChain's go-to-market actually runs on — Salesforce above all: the account and contact model, territory and routing, the sales process from first touch to closed-won, and the quote-to-cash and provisioning stack behind it.
We design and ship internal product for the GTM organization. AI agents do a growing share of the building: they draft design docs, open changes, and run Salesforce deployments, while humans hold the approval gates. Build capacity — engineers plus the agent bench — sits on this team, and you'll help decide what it works on next.

You'll own the requirements, prioritization, and quality bar for LangChain's Salesforce-centered GTM systems, turning ambiguous revenue-team needs into shipped process and systems changes that scale.
This is not a ticket queue role. You'll be accountable for a small number of high-leverage GTM systems programs at a time: defining the problem, aligning stakeholders, specifying the solution, and ensuring what ships changes how the revenue org operates.
You'll work across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Support, and Finance in a fast-changing environment where priorities move quickly and influence matters more than reporting lines. The core challenge is operating with authority but not control: aligning teams around tradeoffs as the business changes underneath the plan.
You won't be expected to write production code. You will be expected to write clear enough specifications that engineers and AI coding agents can build from them, and to review the output with enough Salesforce and systems judgment to decide whether it is correct.
Location: San Francisco Bay Area — in office 4 days a week. The people whose processes you're redesigning are in this building, and so are the engineers who build LangGraph.

Carry multi-quarter programs
Own the Salesforce sales process from lead to close — routing, qualification, territory assignment, and stage progression — driving each initiative from discovery through UAT, change management, and adoption.
Be the person stakeholders come to before they file a request, especially when the system was never designed for what the business now needs.
Own the intake and prioritization model for hundreds of quarterly GTM systems requests, ensuring the team works on the highest-leverage business problems rather than the loudest tickets.
Own what gets specified and what ships
Run discovery and turn ambiguous asks into BRDs, process flows, data models, and acceptance criteria — with a clear problem statement and ROI justification, precise enough to execute without a second conversation.
Hold the quality gate: you write the specification, engineers and coding agents write the code, and nothing reaches production without your sign-off.
Run vendor evaluations when the right answer is buy, integrate, or replace rather than build.
Protect revenue data integrity
Trace anomalies in revenue fields — Net ARR, initial pipeline, lead source — back to the automation, trigger, or integration that wrote them.
Own the reconciliation seam between Salesforce, usage-based billing, and cloud-marketplace transactions.
Identify which design decisions are load-bearing and which are cosmetic, and catch the downstream failure modes before they reach production.

s.h: In your first 6–12 months, you might
s.t:
Redesign the lead-to-opportunity process so routing, qualification, and stage progression are measurable, enforceable, and adopted by the field.
Create a prioritization model for hundreds of GTM systems requests per quarter, with clear tradeoffs and business rationale.
Ship a Salesforce change that improves pipeline hygiene, quote-to-cash accuracy, provisioning reliability, or cloud marketplace reconciliation.
Establish a specification and UAT standard that engineers and AI agents can reliably build against.
Build enough trust with Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Support, and Finance that stakeholders bring you the problem before they prescribe the solution.

s.h: What You'll Need to Be Successful
s.t:
Systems and domain depth
Domain and tenure — 6–8 years in business systems, sales systems, revenue systems, or GTM systems, with Salesforce as your primary platform throughout.
Sales process depth — you've partnered with Sales Ops on the things reps feel every day: territory and account coverage, lead qualification and routing, stage gates, and pipeline and forecast hygiene.
Sales systems / RevOps depth — experience across quote-to-cash, CPQ, territory and lead routing, forecasting, or adjacent revenue processes.
Technical fluency — you can read a data model, a Flow, and enough Apex to design against what's really there, even though you are not expected to write production code.
Program leadership
Program ownership — you've been the single accountable owner, at the working level negotiating the commitments yourself, of a program that spanned four or more functions and changed how a revenue org works day to day.
Release risk — you've delivered a program into a core system on a release process you didn't control, where another team's change could break your release.
Re-scoping under change — you've re-scoped a program mid-flight because the business changed under it, a sponsor moved, or the original scope no longer matched reality.
Holding the line — you've turned down a request with executive backing and kept the relationship; you hold the line when something breaks pricing discipline, a legal constraint, or the architecture, and you arrive with the alternative.
Judgment and communication
One tradeoff, two audiences — you write for the reader in front of you, not the one you find easiest: the VP gets the page, the engineer gets the spec.
Maximum agency — you find the friction and start the project. You don't wait for a ticket.

Help us decide which games are worth building — and how much to invest on the ones that work.
We're looking for a Business Analyst to help decide which new games Wildlife should build, scale, and invest in - and how to do it. You’ll be part of the New Games Product Marketing team at Wildlife Studios.
New Games is where the portfolio of the next few years takes shape. We take concepts — sometimes a single playable ad, sometimes a prototype with a few levels — put them in front of real players and ask: is there a business here, and if so, how do we make it work at scale?

That means figuring out not just whether players want the game, but how to find them and acquire them efficiently. You'll work across experimentation, modeling, product analytics, market and distribution strategy, and investment decisions - often with limited data and no obvious right answer.

You'll need to understand the product, challenge assumptions, figure out what the data can actually tell us, and turn that into a recommendation: what should we build, who should we build it for, how do we reach those players, and how much should we invest?
We work with games from their earliest concepts, even before a line of code exists, all the way through global launch. Throughout that journey, the work is the same: understand the product deeply, dig into the data, help make it better, and figure out the best way to distribute it.
If you like working in a dynamic place, digging into questions where the data is thin and the answer still matters, and sitting close to product rather than downstream of it, this is the seat.

Analysis and experimentation: Analyze player and game performance across engagement, monetization, and cost of acquisition, turning data into a clear read and recommendation. Help design and evaluate tests, from concept tests to soft launches, and be clear about what the data can and cannot prove.
Distribution strategy: Help shape how a new game reaches players, including which markets, channels, audiences, and creative angles to test and at what cost. Analyze where investment should go across platforms like Meta, Google, and TikTok, and understand what each platform is actually optimizing
Support kill, iterate, and scale decisions: Build the analysis and recommendations behind key product decisions, bringing a clear view of what the data tells us and what we should do next.
Modeling under uncertainty: Work with early LTV, payback, and market-size models where data is limited. Understand the assumptions behind them and use them to inform investment and growth decisions.
Launch strategy: For the games that graduate, help shape how they go global, including which markets open when, how fast to ramp, and how much to invest.
Problem prioritization: New games generate more questions than we can answer. Use judgment to identify the problems and analyses most likely to change a product or investment decision, and proactively drive them forward.
Cross-functional teamwork: Work alongside the game team, product, and creative across a title's whole life. Bring the market and player read into product discussions, including what players are responding to and what the numbers say the game still has to fix. Bring the product reality back into how the game gets positioned and distributed.
What you'll need
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Business, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills — you can explain a model to someone who will never read the code.
Working proficiency in SQL, plus Python or R.
Comfort with incomplete data and questions that arrive badly defined.

Familiarity with A/B testing, multivariate testing, and other methodologies for evaluating performance.
Experience with large datasets, BI tooling, or building data pipelines.
Previous experience in user acquisition, performance marketing, growth, banking, or consulting.
Familiarity with the mobile gaming industry landscape.

Proactive and autonomous; you drive initiatives without waiting for instructions, while ensuring necessary visibility and buy-in from key stakeholders.
Thrives in high-demand environments and excels at prioritization.
An exceptional communicator who can influence others — including telling a stakeholder their idea won't work, with the data to support it.
About Wildlife
Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Today, we have offices in Brazil, Argentina, Ireland, and the United States. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!

* Support the administration, configuration, and maintenance of Drug Safety Systems and related applications.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements, identify improvement opportunities, and deliver effective system solutions.
* Support reporting and analytics activities, including standard and ad hoc reports related to medical surveillance, compliance, and operational metrics.

* Act as a primary contact for system issues, coordinating resolution with IT teams and external vendors.
* Provide end-user support, troubleshooting, and training.
* Create and maintain system documentation, procedures (SOPs, WISs), and training materials.

* Continuously develop expertise in Pharmacovigilance/Drug Safety processes, systems, and industry best practices.

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

**Technical Skills**
* Experience with data analysis, reporting, data visualization, and dashboarding tools; experience with Oracle Business Intelligence is an advantage.
* Knowledge of database concepts, data warehousing, and data management principles. Experience with SQL and PL/SQL is desirable.
* Experience with regulated business applications, such as Drug Safety Systems, Quality Management Systems, or Document Management Systems, is an advantage.
**Compliance & Quality**
* Understanding of Computer System Validation (CSV) principles and regulated environments; knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11 is an advantage.
* Exposure to GxP environments and familiarity with GAMP 5 and ITIL concepts is beneficial.
* Strong quality mindset with attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate documentation and compliant processes.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business needs into practical solutions.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn in a dynamic environment.
* Collaborative team player who contributes to a positive and respectful working culture.
* Fluent in English both written and spoken; knowledge of French or German is an advantage.

* **Purpose-driven work:** Contribute to systems that support patient safety and help ensure the safe use of innovative medicines worldwide.
* **Meaningful impact:** Join a collaborative team where your ideas and technical expertise directly contribute to improving business processes and regulated systems.
* **Modern ways of working:** Collaborate with experienced professionals in an environment that values teamwork, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.
The Business Application Development team builds and supports internal and customer-facing systems for licenses, subscriptions, billing, payments, reporting, and many other business-critical functions. Our domain is complex, our systems are interconnected, and there’s always a lot going on. We’re seeking a Senior Business Analyst to join the team and support our efforts.
We’re not looking for someone who will just write requirements. We want someone who likes digging into problems, understanding how things actually work, talking to people, asking uncomfortable questions, and helping teams move toward practical and sustainable solutions.

You’ll work closely with stakeholders, developers, and QA engineers, as well as sales, customer success, and other product teams, to figure out what problem we’re really solving, why it matters, what constraints exist, and what solution makes the most sense long term.
A core responsibility is helping people stay focused on the actual goal instead of jumping straight to a “we need this exact feature” reaction. Though sometimes bigger, the right solution is often smaller than originally expected. The main job is frequently untangling the chaos and helping everyone align.
Organize and improve the intake and analysis process within the team.

s.h: Structure requirements to support effective development.
s.t:
Help developers and QA engineers during implementation when new questions arise.
Investigate unfamiliar areas independently rather than waiting for someone to explain.
Think about edge cases, dependencies, risks, and long-term maintainability.
Help reduce ambiguity around projects.
We care deeply about balancing business value, implementation effort, technical limitations, and platform strategy. We’re not fans of overengineering, but we also don’t like quick hacks that create bigger problems down the line.

s.h: We’ll be happy to bring you on board if you
s.t:
Have solid experience in business analysis within software development teams.
Understand how software development works end-to-end.
Know how to structure complex information and turn messy discussions into clear requirements.
Can stay focused on the core problem and avoid unnecessary complexity.
Are comfortable discussing implementation details with engineers and understanding technical constraints.
Can independently investigate unfamiliar functionality and connect dots across systems.
Care about the overall result, not only your direct area of responsibility.
Are proactive, curious, and comfortable working in an environment where not everything is perfectly documented.
Can adapt your communication style and analytical approach depending on the people and context involved.

s.h: It’d be a plus if you
s.t:
Can work with SQL.
Can read code well enough to understand what’s going on.
Have experience with technically complex systems or system analysis.
Have worked with billing, subscriptions, payments, or within other business-critical domains.

s.h: A few important things to know
s.t:
Our domain is genuinely complex. There’s a lot of history, many integrations, and a large codebase. You won’t learn everything in a month, and that’s okay.
We also continuously adjust processes and ways of working. If you like environments where everything is fixed and strictly defined forever, we’re probably not the best match. If you enjoy figuring things out, improving processes, and helping teams work more effectively together, you’ll likely feel very comfortable here.
Even though you’ll get the team’s full support and onboarding help, we really value people who are curious enough to explore things on their own.

Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience
Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office
Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad
Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love
Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes
Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills
Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays
Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services

It’s never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.
At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.
But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we’re absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that.
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as a Senior Product Functional Analyst. This full-time, permanent position is based in Poland, with the option to work in a hybrid model from any Vistra office in Poland or fully remotely. The role offers global coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact on our business and its growth.
Vistra is a global leader in corporate services, and we're in the middle of one of the most ambitious transformation programmes in our history. Our purpose is progress: we remove the complexity of global business so our clients can move forward without friction.
At the heart of our operational efficiency is Enate, a powerful workflow management platform that orchestrates and automates key business processes across the organisation. Ensuring the stability, performance, and continuous improvement of this platform requires a proactive support professional who thrives on problem-solving, ownership, and delivering results in a fast-paced global environment.
In this role, you will work closely with business users to help them understand and implement Enate process orchestration across the organisation. Partnering with business process owners, service delivery, project, and technical teams, you will deliver tailored solutions that drive operational efficiency and effectiveness. You will be a critical part of the Business Applications global team within the wider AI & Digital function.
Day to day, you will collaborate with Application Support colleagues, cross-functional technology teams, vendors, and Platform/DevOps teams to investigate issues, resolve incidents, and ensure applications continue to meet business needs.
You will report into the Business Applications, Global organisation and play a key role in maintaining application stability, supporting business operations, and delivering a high standard of customer service.

About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Ramp is in a critical phase of growth. We grew immensely last year and are building out a talented business systems team to ensure we maintain this trajectory for years to come. You’ll work directly with our Sales, Account Management, Partnerships, and Product teams to execute mission-critical business systems projects across the organization. This is a key role where you will be uniquely positioned to impact the full picture of Ramp’s growth efforts through systems development.

Own a GTM systems domain end to end: its roadmap, the architecture decisions inside it and its operational health
Build and deploy Salesforce automation end to end: record-triggered and screen flows, validation rules, custom objects and fields, permission sets and approvals
Translate business requirements into solution designs and write them up as the business outcome they produce rather than a list of objects and fields
Prioritize incoming requests against ROI. Make the call on what gets built, what gets deferred, and what gets declined, and show the numbers behind it
Own the integrations across the stack, including lead routing, sequence enrollment, meeting booking, enrichment and partner attribution, spanning Salesforce, HubSpot, LeanData, Outreach, Gong, Chili Piper, ZoomInfo and Workato
Own the dashboards and data models your domain runs on. Translate business questions into reporting that is accurate, documented and actually used to make decisions
Drive cross-functional alignment on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs and carry it through to closure without a manager in the room
Use AI to move faster on flow logic, test cases, documentation and impact analysis and define the guardrails for how the team uses it with GTM data
What You'll Need
5+ years in business systems at a fast-paced company
Salesforce Admin certification or equivalent hands-on experience, plus real depth in HubSpot
Non-trivial Salesforce flows built and debugged when they broke, and a clear view of why declarative automation goes wrong at scale
A habit of framing problems rather than waiting for a spec: ambiguous requests taken on, decided and shipped
Fluency translating business requirements into a solution, and authoring that solution in terms of the outcome it drives and how that outcome will be measured
A metric-driven approach to prioritization: requests ranked on ROI, effort weighed against ongoing maintenance cost and the reasoning made explicit to the requester
Multi-month projects delivered with cross-team dependencies and no PM attached: sequencing the work, holding scope, flagging risk before it lands, clearing blockers rather than reporting them and keeping everyone informed without being asked
Fluency with AI tools to build, audit and document faster and a clear sense of where they stop being reliable

Experience in channel or marketing systems: partner sourcing, revenue share and payouts, or campaign structure, UTM tracking, lead source and multi-touch attribution
Cross-functional program management across engineering, sales and finance stakeholders
A product mindset toward internal tooling: treating stakeholders as users, shipping in phases and measuring adoption after launch
Snowflake, Looker or similar BI and warehouse tooling
Working knowledge of Apex or Lightning Web Components, enough to recognize when declarative is the wrong answer
Linear or similar project management software
Time spent at a high-growth startup or technology company

What will I do in this position if hired? In this position, you will lead, coordinate, and develop analytical processes, methods, and products aligned with the strategic, operational, and administrative requirements of FEMA preparedness, mitigation, response, recovery, mission support, and grants management programs and offices.

Typical assignments include: Leading data management and analytics projects that support strategic planning, program evaluation, business process improvements, and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Working with senior leaders, supervisors, technical partners, and stakeholders to identify goals, define business requirements, develop project specifications, and prioritize analytics products and services.

Translating programmatic needs into technical requirements and communicating technical concepts, data limitations, findings, and recommendations in a clear and actionable manner for varied audiences.

Developing, reviewing, and presenting data-driven analyses, reports, dashboards, briefings, and recommendations to support operational planning, resource decisions, and program performance improvements.

Establishing and maintaining relationships, partnerships, and data-sharing coordination with internal and external stakeholders, including federal, state, local, tribal, territorial, private sector, nonprofit, and academic partners. What else do I need to know?

At FEMA, our mission is to help people before, during and after disasters, and every employee at FEMA has a role in emergency management. Every FEMA employee has regular and recurring emergency management responsibilities, though not every position requires routine deployment to disaster sites.

All positions are subject to recall around the clock for emergency management operations, which may require irregular work hours, work at locations other than the official duty station, and may include duties other than those specified in the employee's official position description.

Travel requirements in support of emergency operations may be extensive in nature (weeks to months), with little advance notice, and may require employees to relocate to emergency sites with physically austere and operationally challenging conditions.
Current Federal employees must have served 52 weeks at the next lower grade or equivalent grade band in the Federal service. The qualification requirements listed below must be met by the closing date of this announcement.

To qualify for this position at the GS-13 level, you must possess one full year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-12 level in the Federal government, which has equipped you with the skills needed to successfully perform the duties of the position.

Experience may be obtained in the federal government, a state or local government, or private sector, and must demonstrate the following: Providing in-depth analyses, strategic assessments, and recommendations on strategic initiatives, program investments, data management activities, analytics projects, or business processes; and Developing, reviewing, and presenting clear, data-driven findings, reports, briefings, dashboards, or recommendations to stakeholders; and Aligning technical requirements, project specifications, workflows, reporting products, or analytics solutions with stakeholder business needs and programmatic requirements; and Managing or coordinating data management and analytics projects, including prioritizing requirements, tracking progress, supporting project execution, and delivering products or services that support decision-making.

College Graduate Hiring Authority Information This position is being filled using the College Graduate Hiring Authority. Under this authority, DHS may make noncompetitive appointments of eligible and qualified college graduates directly into career or career-conditional positions in the competitive service.

Appointments under this authority are limited to professional and administrative positions at the GS-11 level or below, or equivalent. Positions may have promotion potential above the GS-11 level; however, the initial appointment may not exceed the GS-11 level, or equivalent.

Candidates appointed under this authority must serve a one-year probationary period unless they have already satisfied the requirements for career tenure or are otherwise exempt from the service requirement. Competitive status is acquired upon completion of the one-year probationary period.

DHS may make appointments under this authority without regard to veterans' preference and is not subject to rating and ranking procedures; however, DHS adheres to merit system principles in making selections. Eligibility for the College Graduate Hiring Authority This position is being filled under the College Graduate Hiring Authority.

To be eligible for appointment under this authority, you must have completed, within two years of submitting your application, a qualifying bachelor's or graduate degree from a qualifying educational institution. The two-year eligibility period begins on the date the degree is conferred, not the date of the graduation ceremony.

Veterans who completed a bachelor's or graduate degree and were unable to apply within two years of obtaining their degree due to a uniformed service obligation of at least four years may apply within two years of discharge or release from uniformed service.

The intervening period of uniformed service must have prevented the individual from applying within the standard two-year period after completing the degree.

NOTE: Qualifying educational institution means -- Any of the following educational institutions or curricula that have been accredited by an accrediting body recognized by the Secretary of the U.S.

Department of Education: (i) A technical or vocational school;(ii) A 2-year or 4-year college or university;(iii) A graduate or professional school (e.g., law school, medical school). Appointments under this authority are made directly into the competitive service.

Basic Qualification Requirements In addition to meeting the eligibility requirements above, you must meet the OPM-prescribed minimum qualification standards, or OPM-approved agency-specific minimum qualification standards, for the position being filled.

The position is officially titled Management and Program Analyst (Artificial Intelligence). The working/organizational title of this position is Business Analyst.

The Business Analyst improves how CPSC operates by understanding business needs, analyzing data, and translating those needs into clear requirements for a variety of solutions (e.g., technology, automation, business process re-engineering, training, etc.).

This position is responsible for establishing the requirements for complex technical initiatives that support the CPSC's mission and enterprise modernization goals. The Business Analyst collaborates with stakeholders to define a project's scope, technical and functional requirements, and success criteria.

The Business Analyst will: Meet with stakeholders to learn goals, pain points, and current processes. Lead requirements gathering specifically for Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML)-enabled products, including model objectives, training data needs, performance thresholds, evaluation metrics, and human-in-the-loop requirements.

This includes developing user stories, acceptance criteria, and process mapping. Develop functional and non-functional requirements for systems incorporating machine learning, natural language processing, or predictive analytics.

Partner with data engineers, data scientists, IT specialists, and program managers to define data ingestion, labeling, feature engineering, and data quality requirements that support ML model development. Analyze data suitability for algorithmic use and identify data biases, gaps, or limitations.

Support solution design: Work with product, engineering, and business partners to ensure proposed solutions will solve the problem. Participate in model documentation, reproducibility reviews, model cards, and versioning under agency AI governance processes.

Ensure AI/ML solutions align with EO 14110 (Safe, Secure, Trustworthy AI), OMB M-24-10, GAO's AI Accountability Framework, and CPSC's data governance policies. Implement human-centered and values-driven AI design, incorporating transparency and responsible use principles.

Facilitates stakeholder alignment through regular briefings, status updates, and decision-support materials. Prepares and presents project reports, risk assessments, and performance dashboards to ensure transparency and accountability.

Monitor deployed AI/ML solutions for performance drift, data pipeline failures, bias reemergence, or security vulnerabilities. Assess organizational readiness for AI integration and lead stakeholder engagement to ensure alignment with mission needs.

Identify business process changes required for safe and effective AI deployment, including training needs and change-management considerations. Perform additional duties as assigned in support of the CPSC's mission and operational objectives.

GS-13: 1) Experience leading requirements gathering and developing functional and non-functional system requirements for AI/ML solutions; 2) managing programs to evaluate agentic AI solutions; 3) producing test data and analyzing data suitability to determine biases or gaps; 4) ensuring AI/ML solutions comply with federal AI policies; 5) applying project management principles to technology initiatives; and 6) monitoring AI/ML solution performance and recommending improvements to support organizational readiness, training, and change management for AI integration.

Evidence of the above specialized experience must be supported by detailed documentation of duties performed in positions held. Reviews organizational information regarding inventory management, storage management, equipment coordination fiscal and supply management utilizing inspection reports, applicable Department of Army (DA) regulations, and activity mission statements to identify tentative sub-objectives or firm objectives regarding stock record operations. 2.

Conducts troubleshooting and management studies to ascertain the need for changes in existing management systems or methods of operation such as work processes, functional responsibility, operating techniques, organizational structure and other factors effecting the efficient and economical use of available resources. 4.

Develop and support evaluation methodologies for preparedness priorities and focus areas, including logic models, evaluation questions, indicators, data collection plans, and analysis approaches.

What else do I need to know? At FEMA, our mission is to help people before, during and after disasters, and every employee at FEMA has a role in emergency management.

Every FEMA employee has regular and recurring emergency management responsibilities, though not every position requires routine deployment to disaster sites.

All positions are subject to recall around the clock for emergency management operations, which may require irregular work hours, work at locations other than the official duty station, and may include duties other than those specified in the employee's official position description.

Travel requirements in support of emergency operations may be extensive in nature (weeks to months), with little advance notice, and may require employees to relocate to emergency sites with physically austere and operationally challenging conditions.

Wir sind ein bevorzugter Partner für anspruchsvolle Privatkundinnen und -kunden sowie für Unternehmen mit Wachstumspotenzial. Als Tochtergesellschaft der französischen Finanzgruppe Crédit Mutuel Alliance Fédérale legen wir grossen Wert auf Nähe, Unternehmergeist und langfristige Stabilität.

Mit rund 480 Mitarbeitenden an unseren acht Standorten in der Schweiz begleiten wir Sie mit Engagement und Fachkompetenz. Unser Hauptsitz befindet sich in Basel, weitere Filialen haben wir in Freiburg, Genf, Lausanne, Lugano, Neuenburg, Sion und Zürich.
Sind Sie bereit für den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere - gemeinsam mit uns?
## **Ihre Aufgaben** ##
* Sie sind Zuständig für Design und Einführung von digitalen Lösungen im Bereich Accounting (Buchungsregel- und Bilanzierungsregeldefinition), Cost & Fees and Tax (CRS, Withholding Tax, Reportings)
* Sie unterstützen die Fachbereiche bei der Formulierung von Business Requirements
* Sie erstellen innerhalb der vorgegebenen Fristen qualitativ hochwertige Spezifikationen

* Sie erarbeiten Vorschläge zur Umsetzung von Lösungen in Abstimmung mit der IT um sicherzustellen, dass die vorgeschlagene Lösung den fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen entspricht
* Sie sind Zuständig für die Unterstützung der Testkoordinatoren und Tester bei der Erstellung der Testdrehbücher, Begleitung der Benutzertests und Durchführung von Support sowie Benutzerschulungen, um den reibungslosen Übergang vom Projektmodus zum Betrieb sicherzustellen
* Sie pflegen und entwickeln die Anwendungsumgebung weiter, um die Qualität der Anwendungen und die Leistungsfähigkeit der Organisation zu gewährleisten
## **Ihr Profil** ##
Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Wirtschaftsstudium (Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Betriebswirtschaft) und bringen mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung als Business Analyst im Bereich Finance & Accounting mit.

Im Weiteren zeichnen Sie sich durch Ihre Erfahrung mit Banking Accounting Projekten aus (IFRS9, Basel III / IV, Buchungs- und Bilanzierungsregeldefinitionen, Kosten/Gebühren, Tax Projekten), sind idealerweise mit Avaloq vertraut und haben Kenntnisse und Erfahrung in der Projektführung sowie mit Business Requirements Management.

Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen, Ihr organisatorisches Flair sowie Ihr Wille, Verantwortung zu übernehmen gehören zu Ihren Stärken. Sie sind eine Persönlichkeit mit Verhandlungsgeschick, Durchsetzungsvermögen und sicherem Auftreten. Sie sind selbständiges Arbeiten gewohnt und zeigen eine hohe Einsatz- & Leistungsbereitschaft.

Wir erwarten sehr gute Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch, Französisch ist ein grosser Vorteil und weitere Sprachen sind willkommen.

Der Beitritt zur CIC (Schweiz) bedeutet, in einem dynamischen und unternehmerischen Umfeld tätig zu sein, in dem Ihre Kompetenzen wirklich geschätzt werden. Dank unserer überschaubaren Struktur und einer Kultur, die Nähe, Eigenverantwortung und Initiative fördert, findet jede Person ihren Platz und kann ihren beruflichen Weg gestalten.

Ob Sie am Anfang Ihrer Laufbahn stehen oder bereits Expertin bzw. Experte im Bankensektor sind - Sie arbeiten in einem attraktiven, wirkungsorientierten Umfeld, in dem Ihr Beitrag einen echten Unterschied macht und Ihnen reale Entwicklungsperspektiven ermöglichen, aktiv zum Erfolg der Bank beizutragen.

Per completare il nostro team dell'Applications Services all-interno dell-Area Evoluzione Digitale e Tecnologia della Direzione generale cerchiamo un/una
# IT Business Analyst (100%) #
## Profilo: ##
La persona che cerchiamo è specializzata nell'analisi, nella mappatura e nel miglioramento dei processi aziendali in ambito sanitario. Ha il compito di comprendere i processi esistenti, clinici e amministrativi, per identificare inefficienze, ridondanze e opportunità di ottimizzazione, traducendoli in soluzioni IT efficaci e sostenibili.
Analizza e gestisce i processi end-to-end: raccoglie i requisiti, facilita workshop, mappa e ottimizza i processi in collaborazione con il team di sviluppo, li traduce in strumenti low-code e ne cura l'implementazione tecnica, il testing, la formazione utenti e il Change Management, raccogliendo feedback per il miglioramento continuo.
Collabora attivamente con i vari Team presenti all'interno dell-Area, favorendo il coordinamento tra le diverse funzioni coinvolte e contribuendo al miglioramento continuo dei processi e delle soluzioni digitali.
La figura cercata si distingue per una forte attitudine analitica, spiccate capacità di modellazione dei processi, e comprovata esperienza nell'analisi e ottimizzazione di processi di business. Sono richieste ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative, proattività, orientamento al risultato e capacità di facilitare il cambiamento organizzativo in contesti complessi e multidisciplinari.
**Principali compiti:**
* Mappa i processi AS-IS rilevando, documentando e modellando i processi aziendali esistenti (clinici e amministrativi) utilizzando notazioni standard (BPMN).
* Identifica attori, responsabilità, input/output e punti di decisione.
* Analizza i processi mappati per individuare colli di bottiglia, ridondanze, attività a scarso valore aggiunto e rischi operativi, supportando le valutazioni con dati e metriche.
* Progetta i processi TO-BE definendo e formalizzando i processi target ottimizzati, in collaborazione con gli stakeholder e i team tecnici, assicurando coerenza con gli obiettivi strategici e la fattibilità tecnologica.
* Raccoglie e analizza le esigenze aziendali attraverso interviste, Workshop, osservazioni e analisi documentale, traducendole in requisiti funzionali e non funzionali chiari e tracciabili (user stories, casi d'uso, diagrammi di flusso).
* Definisce le soluzioni traducendo i requisiti e i processi TO-BE in specifiche per soluzioni tecnologiche, lavorando in stretta collaborazione con i team di sviluppo e architettura.
* Supporta la gestione del cambiamento accompagnando l'organizzazione nell'adozione dei nuovi processi e soluzioni, curando la formazione degli utenti, la documentazione operativa e la gestione delle resistenze al cambiamento.
* Monitorizza il miglioramento continuo definendo KPI di processo, monitoraggio delle performance delle soluzioni implementate e propone interventi correttivi basati su dati e feedback degli utenti.
* Collabora attivamente con Product Owner, Service Owner, Business Relationship Manager, Project Manager, Team di sviluppo e Team UX/UI, garantendo l'allineamento tra esigenze funzionali, design dei processi e sviluppo applicativo.
* Gestisce gli stakeholder mantenendo una comunicazione continua con le funzioni aziendali (cliniche e amministrative), facilitando la comprensione reciproca e fungendo da catalizzatore tra business e IT.
* Garantisce il rispetto delle linee guida IT interne relative al ruolo di Business Analyst, promuovendo l'adozione di best practice di Process Management e assicurando il costante aggiornamento della documentazione.
## Requisiti necessari: ##
* Diploma di scuola superiore (ad esempio SSIG) oppure titolo accademico di livello bachelor o master in informatica.
* Competenza avanzata nella modellazione dei processi tramite notazione BPMN e relativi strumenti (per esempio: Visio, Signavio, Miro).
* Conoscenze in Business Process Management (BPM/BPMN).
* Comprovata esperienza nella mappatura di processi AS-IS e nella progettazione di processi TO-BE.
* Conoscenza avanzata delle tecniche di raccolta e documentazione dei requisiti (interviste, workshop, user stories, casi d'uso, diagrammi di flusso).
* Conoscenza di metodologie Agile (Scrum e Kanban) e capacità di applicarle in progetti di trasformazione dei processi.
* Conoscenza avanzata degli strumenti di gestione progetti e documentazione (Jira, Confluence).
* Conoscenza di strumenti per la gestione di processi low-code (per esempio: Flowable e Camunda).
* Capacità di definire e monitorare KPI di processo per guidare decisioni basate sui dati.
* Ottime capacità relazionali, di comunicazione e mediazione, con esperienza nella facilitazione di workshop e gruppi di lavoro multidisciplinari.
* Ottime capacità analitiche e di problem solving, con attitudine a identificare root cause e proporre soluzioni strutturate.
* Orientamento ai risultati e capacità di gestire priorità diverse in contesti complessi.
**Costituiscono titolo preferenziale:**
* Esperienza in ambito sanitario o ospedaliero, in particolare nell'analisi di processi clinici o amministrativo-sanitari.
* Formazione in informatica medica.
* Certificazioni in Business Process Management.
* Certificazioni in Lean Management, Six Sigma o metodologie di miglioramento continuo.
* Certificazioni in metodologie Agile.
* Certificazioni in Project Management.
* Conoscenza e certificazioni di strumenti low-code.
* Conoscenza dell-inglese e/o di una seconda lingua nazionale.
**Cosa offriamo:**
* Un contesto ospedaliero dinamico e orientato all'innovazione.
* Possibilità di incidere concretamente sull'affidabilità dei servizi digitali sanitari.
* Opportunità di crescita professionale nell'ambito della digitalizzazione dei processi.
